interface.shortDescription: Run managed agents with shared project conventions.
interface.longDescription: Provides three public Skills: Agent for complete local workflows in direct, work, work-verification, and plan-work-verification modes Convention for shared rules, authority, and core semantics, and Document for authoring, storage, and Codex synchronization. No MCP package, server, account, tenant, connection, or authenticated resource is required.
